As above used, the terms provincial treasurers, provincial
division superintendents of schools, and district health
officers shall be construed to embrace the officials of a chartered
city corresponding to these positions,
For the purpose of determining the amourt of transportation
allowances of the officials of a particular province or city,
the District or City Engineer thereof, as the case may be, shall
certify the number of kilometers of designated first and second
class roads connected with the provincial capital or city, before
an allowance for a privately owned motor vehicle (automobile or
jeep) is granted.
The above rates of maximum transportation allowances shall also
apply to government-owned automobiles and jeeps exclusively assigned to
an official.

3. All motor vehicies owned by a province or chartered city
for common use shall be kept in a central garag to be operated
by the District or City Engineer who shall rent such vehicle to
officials making designated rips for official purposes in the
order in which applications are received and after taking into
consideration the relative urgency of the propsed trip.
Motor vehicles purchased, from the road and bridge fund or
streets and bridges fund for the official use of the District
or City Engineer and his assistants and those purchased from
other provincial or city finds exclusively assigned for the use
of one office shall not be operated for comma use, unless the
